facts.claim: Commit 8aea559fceb8445e980e1d22b12df1ff343a9985 adds an offline snapshot handler with a deny-by-default key flag, key/project policy intersection, and direct API-key credential-kind filtering. The gateway's focused snapshot tests and full API suite passed.

evidence.method: go test ./...; GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.23.12 go test ./...; go vet ./...; go run honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@latest ./...

facts.claim: An opt-in HTTP fixture started the real gateway handler, issued a project-key-scoped snapshot and let Node, Python and Go save it. After the gateway listener closed, all three sent both JSON and incremental SSE Chat requests to a synthetic Anthropic-shaped direct target, converted the answers and reached a success terminal. Three consecutive local runs passed.

A real upstream provider account, entitlement and the behavior of all vendor-specific media, tool or opaque stream fields were not established by fixture traffic. This SDK preview does not certify those paths.

GitHub main-branch CI for commit 8aea559 passed, including Go build, vet, test, race, vulnerability scan, platform-specific checks, console tests and committed-dist verification, cross-compilation and deterministic Docker acceptance. Its Pages workflow also succeeded. CI does not separately run the three SDK module suites.

evidence.method: gh run watch --exit-status and gh run view for the exact commit; gh run list for Pages

conclusion.summary: Propose baseline reuse of the accepted SDK-preview contract for exact committed source 8aea559. The five assertions are supported by gateway snapshot tests, the three language suites on their stated runtimes, and a repeated cross-language real-handler/synthetic-upstream JSON-plus-SSE fixture. Source-only publication does not claim real-provider entitlement, media/tool stream translation, SDK package registry publication, encrypted cache or offline quota enforcement. Operator confirmation of this exact baseline review is required before certification.
